title: Add hunked invocation aggregator and latency micro-drift panel
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Long-tail latency and per-token cost noise make SLOs noisy for customers with mixed prompt shapes. We introduce a lightweight 'hunk' abstraction (contiguous token segments with fingerprinted shape metadata) to reduce cardinality while preserving signal for micro-regressions. This PR implements a hunked invocation aggregator in the telemetry collector, a companion latency micro-drift dashboard, and an SLO noise-gating adapter that uses hunk-cohort variance to reduce false-positive alerts.

What this changes (high level):
- Adds invocation_hunk_* metrics for per-hunk latency, token_count, hw_cost_estimate and kv_cache_hits. Metric names are additive; existing telemetry consumers are untouched.
- Collector-side aggregator that groups per-invocation spans into hunks (configurable window in ms and token boundaries) and emits aggregated rollups to the metrics pipeline.
- Dashboard: dashboards/observability/latency-microdrift-panel.json provides micro-drift visualizations (per-hunk centroid latency over time, cohort variance band, and heatmap of hunk hotness).
- SLO noise gate: an alert pre-processor that applies a variance-aware suppression for high-entropy hunk cohorts to avoid noisy pager churning. The default gate is conservative and opt-in per-alert.
- Config: new collector flags: --hunk-window-ms, --hunk-sample-rate, --hunk-cohort-key (defaults provided).
- Docs & runbook: docs/observability/hunk-aggregator.md describes deployment, knob tuning, and expected metric shapes.

Design notes:
- Hunk fingerprinting uses a stable hash of (prompt-shape, truncation, generation-mode) and a time-window bucket to limit cardinality. We intentionally avoid user PII in the fingerprint.
- Sampling: collector applies reservoir sampling across invocations before hunk aggregation to bound ingestion cost. We expose sample rate as a runtime flag; defaults tuned in this PR to 0.05 for hosted and 0.20 for dedicated testing clusters.
- Backward compatibility: no existing metric names are removed or mutated. Old consumers can ignore the new invocation_hunk_* series.
- Safety: aggregator is CPU-bounded and uses a bounded in-memory buffer per-shard. There is an emergency disable flag (--hunk-enabled=false) for rollbacks.

Testing & rollout:
- Unit tests cover hunk detection edge cases (token boundaries, truncation behavior). Integration test simulates mixed prompt shapes to validate cohort variance calculation. Loadbench run on perf-canary showed ~3% CPU overhead at 50k rps with sampling enabled.
- Staged rollout: enable on a few low-traffic tenants for 24h, inspect micro-drift panel and alert suppression history, then expand.

Checklist: 
- [x] Collector instrumentation and aggregator implementation
- [x] Dashboard and panels added
- [x] Docs and runbook
- [x] Unit + integration tests
- [x] Feature flag + conservative defaults

Linear/JIRA: Linked Linear items ENG-4567 (hunk aggregator design), ENG-4612 (dashboard + noise gate). Support follow-up SUP-773 (customer tuning).

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the sampling semantics (collector/reservoir interaction), dashboard query performance for high-cardinality cohorts, and the SLO suppression heuristics. If we want a stricter retention policy for hunk rollups I can add TTLs to the emit path in a follow-up.
commits: Init: add hunk aggregator module, basic interfaces and feature flag
Telemetry: emit invocation_hunk_* metrics and cohort fingerprint code
Collector: reservoir sampling integration and bounded buffer enforcement
Dashboard: add latency-microdrift-panel.json and helper queries
SLO: noise-gate preprocessor and alert opt-in knobs
Tests: unit tests for hunk detection + integration test for cohort variance
Docs: add docs/observability/hunk-aggregator.md and runbook snippets
review_comments: Evan Cho: Can we make the reservoir sampling deterministic across restarts for a given shard? non-determinism makes debugging cohort diffs hard. (requested change)

Priya Nair: Good point — made sampling seed deterministic derived from shard id + epoch; updated sampler to persist short-lived seed in memory only. Added unit test to validate deterministic selection for a shard.
Ravi Patel: Dashboard queries look expensive at high cardinality. Can we add a pre-aggregation path or limit the backfill window? (requested change)
Priya Nair: Added a pre-aggregation rollup every 5m for hot hunk cohorts and limited heatmap backfill to 24h by default; panel includes a 'full-history' toggle for power users.
Marta Alvarez: Approving — sampling knobs and emergency disable flag look good. Please include a short note in the runbook about how to tune --hunk-sample-rate for heavy tenants. (approved)
release_notes: Add hunked invocation aggregation and latency micro-drift dashboard; introduce variance-aware SLO noise gate; new invocation_hunk_* metrics emitted; conservative defaults and feature flag for rollout.
